abstract: A 72-year-old Japanese man presented with a painless swollen left scrotal mass with elevated levels of serum alpha-fetoprotein and prostate specific antigen. The patient underwent high orchiectomy under diagnosis and a final pathological examination revealed embryonal carcinoma of the left testis. A systematic needle prostate biopsy under guidance of transrectal ultrasound revealed prostate cancer (Gleason score, 8) on the left lobe (T2aN0M0). Systemic chemotherapy was given for retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis of testicular cancer and hormonal therapy (LH-RH analog) was given for prostate cancer. The patient was well with no evidence of metastasis from the testicular cancer or prostate cancer and with no elevation of serum alpha-fetoprotein or prostate specific antigen 26 months after the orchiectomy.
abstract_ja: 72歳の日本人男性が、左陰嚢の無痛性腫大とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)および前立腺特異抗原(PSA)の高値を主訴に受診した。診断目的で高位精巣摘除術を施行し、病理学的検査で左精巣の胎児性癌と判明した。経直腸超音波ガイド下の系統的針生検では、左葉に前立腺癌(Gleason score 8、T2aN0M0)が認められた。精巣がんの後腹膜リンパ節転移に対して全身化学療法を施行し、前立腺癌にはLH-RHアナログによるホルモン療法を行った。精巣摘除術後26か月の時点で、精巣がんおよび前立腺癌の転移の所見はなく、AFPおよびPSAの上昇もみられていない。
